_notes: Phase 1 resources. starting = amount in a fresh game. baseCap = storage always available before HQ/Storage bonuses (HQ effects.storageAdded and Storage buildings add on top; see buildings.json). Survivors are capped by housing (HQ + Shelters), not storage. Production that would exceed a cap is lost. survivorArrival: a new survivor joins every intervalSeconds while housing is free and food >= foodCost (food is spent). foodUpkeepPerSurvivorPerMin is 0 in Phase 1 (knob kept for later). All times are in-game seconds at 1x speed.
